title: Rolling deprecation cadence with pin guidance, telemetry-linked rollback, and profile archival
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Define and implement a rolling deprecation workflow for legacy model versions that couples (1) staged customer notices, (2) automated SDK and Console pin guidance, (3) published performance profile archival, and (4) telemetry-driven rollback triggers. Goal: minimize surprise regressions for customers who have pinned versions or rely on performance profiles while keeping the model catalog healthy and searchable.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Communication templates (email, in-console, support scripts) exist and are approved; 2) Console shows a clear deprecation banner and one-click pin/migrate suggestions; 3) SDK emits non-breaking warnings 30/14/7 days before sunset and a hard error only after policy date; 4) Performance profiles for deprecated versions are moved to an archival page with versioned URLs and an unlisted flag; 5) Telemetry dashboards surface regression signals (latency P95, token-cost delta, error-rate) and trigger a runbook if thresholds exceeded; 6) Playbook validated with a staged canary (5 internal customers) and a public pilot group.
rollout_plan: Week 1: Finalize notice cadence and templates; Week 2: Implement Console banner + one-click pin/migrate UX; Week 3: SDK warning release (minor semver) and publish migration guides; Week 4: Enable telemetry dashboards, run internal pilot; Week 5: Public pilot with 10 customers; Week 6: Start rolling deprecation for low-risk models (30-day notice), monitor, iterate; Full rollout gated on metrics and pilot feedback.
communication_plan: Tiered notices: 30-day heads-up (informational), 14-day reminder (recommended action + migration doc), 7-day escalation (support offer + migration assistance), and day-of sunset (final notice with fallback behavior). Channels: in-Console banner, billing emails, workspace admin email, in-SDK warnings, and Support/CS outreach for customers with pinned models. Templates and translations live in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/MODEL/Sunset+Communications. Support playbook PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/672
migration_guides: Create per-model migration guides mapping old->recommended variants with compatibility notes (tokenization, output-format, sampling defaults). Include example migration snippets for REST and SDKs, and automated linters that detect pinned versions and suggest 'PATCH' or 'MAJOR' remediation. Draft location: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-model-migrations. SDK warning PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/410
telemetry_requirements: Dashboards capturing: per-version request volume, P50/P95 latency, token-cost per request, top error classes, hallucination regressions from eval suite, and customer-visible QoE metrics. Alert rules: P95 latency increase >30% vs baseline OR token-cost increase >25% OR error-rate >0.5% sustained for 1h -> create incident and evaluate rollback. Dashboard prototype: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/pm-deprecations
operational_playbook: Runbook steps: 1) If alert fires, notify on-call infra + PM + eng; 2) Triage to determine root cause (kernel mismatch, quantization regressions, inference config drift); 3) If customer-impacting, initiate rollback to previous catalog state and re-open model availability; 4) Communicate to affected customers within 30 minutes via status page and targeted messages. Rollback API: ENG to implement 'catalog-revert' endpoint (ENG-8891).
notes: Decisions/tradeoffs: - Default policy will be 60-day notice for major-weight changes and 30-day for minor variants. - We will avoid silent removals; deprecated performance profiles become read-only and move to an 'archive' namespace. - Tradeoff: aggressive archival reduces surface area for confusion but increases support load; mitigations include clear migration paths and proactive CS outreach. - Consider future automation: auto-suggested pin for customers with heavy traffic on soon-to-be-removed versions (opt-in).
